# renderer

`draw_version::component` and `ultrawide::component` extend renderer behavior with watermark/version overlays and runtime custom-aspect-ratio management.

## Contents

- [draw_version.cpp](./draw_version.cpp) — `draw_version::component` schedules `cg_draw_watermark()` and `cg_draw_version()`; `REGISTER_COMPONENT` remains commented out.
- [ultrawide.cpp](./ultrawide.cpp) — `ultrawide::component` registers aspect-ratio dvars, console commands, lifecycle hooks, and renderer-memory synchronization.
- [ultrawide.hpp](./ultrawide.hpp) — Declares `set_custom_resolution_command()`, `reset_custom_resolution_command()`, `dump_ultrawide_command()`, and `apply_ultrawide_now_command()`.

## File Relationships

`draw_version::component::post_load()` connects `scheduler::pipeline::renderer` to `cg_draw_watermark()` and `cg_draw_version()`.

`ultrawide::component::post_load()` schedules dvar and command initialization through `scheduler::main`, while `pre_destroy()` clears `dvars::r_aspectRatioCustomEnable`, `dvars::r_aspectRatioCustom`, and `dvars::r_ultrawideCustomMode`.

`set_custom_resolution_command()` updates `r_customMode`, `r_ultrawideCustomMode`, `r_aspectRatioCustomEnable`, and `r_aspectRatioCustom`, then queues `vid_restart`.

## Behavioral Contracts

`cg_draw_watermark()` draws `"Project: Consolation"` with `watermark_font_scale = 0.25f`, `watermark_margin_x = 8.0f`, and `watermark_margin_y = 6.0f`.

`cg_draw_version()` reads the `"version"` dvar and uses `cg_drawVersionX = 50.0f`, `cg_drawVersionY = 18.0f`, and `version_font_scale = 1.0f`.

`draw_text_shadowed()` calls `game::R_AddCmdDrawText` for shadow and foreground layers using offsets `1.0f, 1.0f`, `shadow_color = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.65f}`, and `text_color = {0.86f, 0.82f, 0.72f, 0.60f}`.

`parse_resolution()` requires `std::sscanf(text.c_str(), "%ix%i", &width, &height) == 2` and rejects non-positive dimensions.

`r_aspectRatioCustom` defaults to `16.0f / 9.0f` and clamps between `4.0f / 3.0f` and `63.0f / 9.0f`.

`r_ultrawideCustomMode` defaults to `"disabled"` and stores custom `WxH` resolution text.

`setcustomres` requires `<width>x<height>` and emits `"usage: setcustomres <width>x<height>\n"` for invalid input.

`apply_custom_aspect_ratio()` uses the `1.5f` widescreen threshold and computes monitor/render aspects from `custom_ratio`, renderer dimensions, and captured original values.

`aspect_ratio_scalar` resolves `0x1127BAEC`; `custom_mode_fullscreen_gate` resolves `0x103BE1C9` and remains unused.

`renderer_aspect_ratio`, `renderer_monitor_width`, `renderer_monitor_height`, `renderer_render_width`, `renderer_render_height`, `renderer_monitor_aspect`, and `renderer_render_aspect` resolve `0x10E271AC`, `0x10E27190`, `0x10E27194`, `0x10E27198`, `0x10E2719C`, `0x10E271B0`, and `0x10E271B4`.

## Safety Conditions

`cg_draw_watermark()` and `cg_draw_version()` abort when dvars, fonts, viewport dimensions, or text values are unavailable.

`resolve_layout_width()` falls back to `640.0f`; `resolve_layout_height()` falls back to `480.0f`.

`get_line_height()` falls back to `18.0f * scale` when `Font_s::pixelHeight` is unavailable.

`sync_sticky_custom_resolution_state()` falls back to `false` and `16.0f / 9.0f` for invalid or absent custom-resolution state.
